design_references.title: Deterministic distiller extension
design_references.claim: Section 9 URL extraction extension: deterministic source fidelity and process cost.

hypothesis: Distiller retains at least as many exact source code blocks, MathML structures, links and declared table invariants as xberg on the two frozen fixtures.
null_hypothesis: Xberg retains more of any declared fidelity component, preventing a distiller dominance verdict.
independent_variable: CLI extractor implementation with supported input adapter: distiller loopback HTTP versus xberg local file; identical bytes.

environment.network_justification: Both URL extractors receive identical frozen HTML from a local HTTP server; no WAN or LLM calls.

variants.name: xberg
variants.description: Installed xberg-cli 1.3.7; Markdown output, OCR and cache disabled, config discovery disabled. Local file input because URL loopback is denied. Explicit HTML MIME type avoids XML auto-detection for source containing MathML.

randomness.justification: Frozen deterministic sources; alternating CLI order, one warmup then five measurements per fixture and variant.

metrics.primary: Exact preformatted source code blocks retained, preserving indentation and blank lines.
secondary: MathML tag/text structure retained (alternative math representation equivalence unverified)
Synthetic empty cells and colspan/rowspan preserved
metrics.acceptance_rule: A fixture-scoped fidelity winner must be no worse in every declared fidelity component and better in at least one. Timing is descriptive and cannot compensate for fidelity loss. Otherwise report ties/tradeoffs. No general superiority or architecture promotion.

evaluator.rubric: Independent stdlib HTMLParser source oracle; fenced-code exact comparison with only a missing terminal newline tolerated. Math tag/text trees retain attributes and ignore insignificant whitespace; report representation retention, not semantic equivalence. All source non-fragment links resolved against loopback URL; only Markdown link destinations and HTML hrefs count. Synthetic table empty cell and span checks; one warmup excluded, five timed repetitions, retain failures and all raw outputs. Abort on timeout, nonzero exit, excess output or varying fidelity.
